artists.name: Hudson Westbrook
artists.bio: Hudson Westbrook is a self-taught, soulful country singer-songwriter from Texas who blends heartfelt lyrics with a touch of rock. His debut album "Texas Forever" was released on July 25th. His music explores themes of family, love, hard work, and personal struggles. Westbrook's first single, "Take It Slow", went viral on social media after he started playing it in a Guitar Center and a future bandmate joined in. He released "Two Way Drive" the following month and went all in on his music, buying a van, trailer, and sound equipment.

artists.name: Don Toliver
artists.bio: Caleb Zackery “Don” Toliver (born June 12, 1994), is a rapper, singer, and songwriter from Houston, Texas. Toliver began his musical career in May 2017, releasing the collaborative mixtape Playa Familia with friend and fellow rapper Yungjosh93. Don Toliver’s solo debut came just a few months later, with the debut singles “I Gotta” and “Diva” dropping in November and December, respectively. The singles quickly caught the ear of Atlantic Records, which signed Toliver to the label in March 2018.
